label: Bible Study
prompt: Lo, children are an _____ of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
verse: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
note: Solomon's psalm about building houses — and the best inheritance is children.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The _____ of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verse: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
note: The very last verse of the whole Bible is a blessing of grace.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Children, obey your _____ in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
verse: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
note: The children's memory verse comes with a bonus line: obeying your parents is 'well pleasing unto the Lord.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but _____ edifieth.
verse: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.
note: Corinth's know-it-alls argued over idol meat; Paul says knowledge inflates egos, but love builds people up.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the _____: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.
verse: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.
note: Isaac went out 'to meditate in the field at the eventide' — and looked up to see Rebekah's camels coming.
